name: nl-eli-mcp
description: Dutch law with verifiable citations: consolidated legislation from the BWB (wetten.overheid.nl via the official KOOP search service), as in force on a chosen date, with persistent BWB identifiers, and court decisions from Rechtspraak Open Data by ECLI. Every answer carries the official source and identifier, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to these official Dutch sources; nothing goes to MateMatic.
